title: gladiolus segetum subsp. guepinii
intro: Gladiolus segetum subsp. guepinii, commonly known as the Mediterranean Cornflower or Guepin's Cornflower, is a perennial plant native to the Mediterranean region. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The plant is also reported to have therapeutic actions, including anti-spasmodic, diuretic, and expectorant properties. Gladiolus segetum subsp. guepinii contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
